description: Equip the best tool in inventory for breaking a target block. Specify the block by coordinates (x,y,z) or by blockId (nearest matching block within 64 is used). With getFromChest, retrieves a suitable tool from a configured tool chest if none is held.

blockId.description: Block name/id to find the nearest of (when no coords given)

getFromChest.description: Retrieve a tool from a configured chest if none held (default false)

maxTools.description: Max tools to pull from chest at once (default 1)

requireHarvest.description: Only use tools that can actually harvest the block (default false)

x.description: X coordinate of the target block

y.description: Y coordinate of the target block

z.description: Z coordinate of the target block

name: equip_tool_for_block
